answer_1.quote: we aim to evaluate the puzzle-solving abilities of LLMs by themselves, without the use of any external logic solvers.
answer_1.outputs: reasoning chains and final answers for grid-based logic puzzles

answer_2.quote: we propose PuzzleEval, an LLM-based framework to evaluate reasoning chains for grid-based puzzles.

answer_3.quote: we propose to leverage LLMs as auto-evaluators by creating prompts that utilize error taxonomy to automate the analysis of reasoning chains and help in identifying errors

answer_4.quote: we conduct a detailed manual analysis of the reasoning chains generated by them while solving grid-based puzzles. Details of the annotation guidelines provided to the human evaluators are given in the Appendix D.
answer_4.guideline: segmenting reasoning chains into individual sentences, identifying premise and conclusion for each sentence, determining correctness, and categorizing errors based on proposed taxonomy
